primary_endpoint: Change from baseline in mean liver fat at week 52.
efficacy_outcome: Mean liver fat changed by −3.18% with Aramchol 600 mg, −3.41% with 400 mg, and −0.09% with placebo. Reported p-values were 0.0655 and 0.0450, respectively (the source does not specify which p-value corresponds to each dose).
safety_signal: Serious AEs occurred in 9/98 participants on Aramchol 600 mg, 9/101 on 400 mg, and 6/48 on placebo; no deaths were reported.
